name: Balerion
description: The largest dragon in recorded history. His fire could melt stone and steel. Aegon rode him during the conquest of Westeros.

name: Vhagar
description: The oldest and second largest dragon during the Dance of Dragons. Ridden by three dragonriders across history.

name: Meraxes
description: One of the three dragons of the conquest. Meraxes was slain in Dorne with Rhaenys still on her back.

name: Drogon
description: The largest of Daenerys's three dragons, named after Khal Drogo. Black as coal with red markings.

name: Rhaegal
description: Named after Rhaegar Targaryen. Green and bronze scaled, killed by Euron Greyjoy's scorpions.

name: Syrax
description: Rhaenyra Targaryen's dragon. A large yellow she-dragon who died during the storming of the Dragonpit.

name: Caraxes
description: A fearsome red dragon ridden by Prince Daemon Targaryen. Known for his serpentine neck and ferocious temperament.

name: Meleys
description: One of the fastest dragons in Westeros. Ridden by Princess Rhaenys Targaryen, known as the Queen Who Never Was.

name: Vermithor
description: The second largest dragon alive during the Dance of Dragons. Once ridden by King Jaehaerys I, later claimed by Hugh Hammer.

name: Silverwing
description: A she-dragon with silver scales, once ridden by Good Queen Alysanne. She refused to cross the Wall twice.

name: Sunfyre
description: Considered the most beautiful dragon in the world. Golden scales with pale pink wings, ridden by King Aegon II Targaryen.

name: Tyraxes
description: Ridden by Joffrey Velaryon, second son of Rhaenyra. Tyraxes was killed during the storming of the Dragonpit by a mob.

name: Arrax
description: A young dragon ridden by Lucerys Velaryon. Killed by Vhagar over Shipbreaker Bay in a confrontation that ignited the Dance of Dragons.

name: The Cannibal
description: A massive wild dragon who lurked in the caves of Dragonstone. Never tamed, he fed on the carcasses and eggs of other dragons. His fate is unknown.

name: Sheepstealer
description: A wild dragon eventually claimed by Nettles, a dragonseed girl who tamed him by feeding him fresh-slaughtered sheep each morning.

name: Grey Ghost
description: A wild, shy dragon who lived on Dragonstone and fed on fish from the sea. Never tamed. Killed by the Cannibal during the Dance of Dragons.

name: Tessarion
description: A beautiful cobalt blue she-dragon ridden by Prince Daeron Targaryen, youngest son of Viserys I. Killed at the Second Battle of Tumbleton.

name: Seasmoke
description: A pale grey and silver dragon ridden by Laenor Velaryon. After Laenor's death he was later claimed by Addam of Hull.

name: Dreamfyre
description: A pale blue and silver she-dragon ridden by Helaena Targaryen. Killed during the storming of the Dragonpit, bringing down the dome as she died.

name: Moondancer
description: A small, young she-dragon ridden by Baela Targaryen. Mortally wounded in battle against Aegon II on Sunfyre.

name: Vermax
description: Ridden by Jacaerys Velaryon, eldest son of Rhaenyra. Died at the Battle of the Gullet along with his rider.

name: Viserion
description: One of Daenerys's three dragons, cream and gold in color. Killed by the Night King beyond the Wall and reanimated as an ice dragon.

name: Morning
description: A young pink and red she-dragon hatched during the Dance of Dragons, ridden by Rhaena Targaryen. One of the last dragons to survive the civil war.

name: Quicksilver
description: Ridden by King Aenys I. A swift but relatively small dragon, killed in battle against Maegor the Cruel riding Balerion.

name: Stormcloud
description: A young dragon ridden by Aegon Targaryen, third son of Rhaenyra. Mortally wounded defending his rider from enemy arrows at the Battle of the Gullet.
